entries.title: Hebrews 13:1
segments: Let love of the brethren continue.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:2
segments: Forget not to show love unto strangers: for thereby some have entertained angels unawares.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:3
segments: Remember them that are in bonds, as bound with them; them that are illtreated, as being yourselves also in the body.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:4
segments: [Let] marriage [be] had in honor among all, and [let] the bed [be] undefiled: for fornicators and adulterers God will judge.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:5
segments: Be ye free from the love of money; content with such things as ye have: for himself hath said, I will in no wise fail thee, neither will I in any wise forsake thee.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:6
segments: So that with good courage we say, The Lord is my helper; I will not fear: What shall man do unto me?

entries.title: Hebrews 13:7
segments: Remember them that had the rule over you, men that spake unto you the word of God; and considering the issue of their life, imitate their faith.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:8
segments: Jesus Christ [is] the same yesterday and to-day, [yea] and for ever.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:9
segments: Be not carried away by divers and strange teachings: for it is good that the heart be established by grace; not by meats, wherein they that occupied themselves were not profited.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:10
segments: We have an altar, whereof they have no right to eat that serve the tabernacle.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:11
segments: For the bodies of those beasts whose blood is brought into the holy place by the high priest [as an offering] for sin, are burned without the camp.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:12
segments: Wherefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people through his own blood, suffered without the gate.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:13
segments: Let us therefore go forth unto him without the camp, bearing his reproach.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:14
segments: For we have not here an abiding city, but we seek after [the city] which is to come.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:15
segments: Through him then let us offer up a sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of lips which make confession to his name.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:16
segments: But to do good and to communicate forget not: for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:17
segments: Obey them that have the rule over you, and submit [to them]: for they watch in behalf of your souls, as they that shall give account; that they may do this with joy, and not with grief: for this [were] unprofitable for you.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:18
segments: Pray for us: for we are persuaded that we have a good conscience, desiring to live honorably in all things.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:19
segments: And I exhort [you] the more exceedingly to do this, that I may be restored to you the sooner.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:20
segments: Now the God of peace, who brought again from the dead the great shepherd of the sheep with the blood of an eternal covenant, [even] our Lord Jesus,

entries.title: Hebrews 13:21
segments: make you perfect in every good thing to do his will, working in us that which is well-pleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ; to whom [be] the glory for ever and ever. Amen.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:22
segments: But I exhort you, brethren, bear with the word of exhortation, for I have written unto you in few words.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:23
segments: Know ye that our brother Timothy hath been set at liberty; with whom, if he come shortly, I will see you.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:24
segments: Salute all them that have the rule over you, and all the saints. They of Italy salute you.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:25
segments: Grace be with you all. Amen.
